test_title: SSC CHSL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a part of an email address?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Photo.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **A photo is NOT part of an email address**. While users can typically associate a profile picture with their email account, this photo is not considered part of the email address itself.
 
• It is not included in any email addresses** nor is it required for sending or receiving emails.**
 
• An email address consists of a username, the '@' symbol, and the** **email service provider's domain.
 
• For example, in the email address "username@example.com", "username"** **is the chosen identifier for the user, "@" is used to separate the parts of the email, and "example.com" is the email service provider's domain.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Email service provider’s domain: **This is the website that hosts your email account, such as gmail.com, yahoo.com, or hotmail.com.
 
• **'@' symbol**: This symbol separates the user's name from the service provider's domain in every email address.
 
• **Username:** This is the name that the user has picked for themselves. It is unique to each user within the email service provider’s domain.
